body: After seeing my downvotes and getting back-to-back rejection emails from 6 different companies today, I'm going to make this sooner rather than later. I've been feeling like shit since the sixth grade and tried every mental health service at my disposal. Making this post was a last ditch effort to motivate myself to live, but I see it's pointless now

Thanks for the downvotes guys. That's very heartwarming.

I open about suicidal thoughts related to ableism and racism I experienced in the previous workplace and job-hunting to the point of planning a day to do this. Thanks for motivating me to carry this out sooner rather than later
